items.proposed: other (tumours with actionable ALK/BRAF/NTRK mutations excluded) as eligibility, candidate_matched false
items.reason: Exclusion: 'Have known pathogenic somatic mutations appropriate for an anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK), B-rapidly accelerated fibrosarcoma (BRAF), or neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK ) inhibitor' is a tumour molecular entry condition (absence required). Not linked to abemaciclib.

items.proposed: drop CDKN2A_B as eligibility (no row, or exploratory/diagnostic only)
items.reason: 'IDH-mutant astrocytoma with homozygous CDKN2A/B deletion' is one of many alternative WHO 2021 diagnoses, i.e. part of a diagnostic definition, not a trial-wide entry requirement or a cohort/arm requirement, so it is neither eligibility nor enrichment.

items.coder_A: CDKN2A/B deletion appears only as part of the definition of one of many eligible diagnoses (not a trial-wide requirement); coded not matched, but a CDK4/6 inhibitor with CDKN2A/B deletion could be read as candidate-matched enrichment.
items.reason: Although CDKN2A loss + CDK4/6 inhibitor is a manual example of a match, here CDKN2A/B deletion only defines one eligible diagnosis among many and no cohort or arm requires it, so it is not an eligibility or enrichment biomarker.

note: Primary outcome is false under either coder's biomarker; only any_molecular_selection depends on XL's view. If XL decides a molecular exclusion (absence of actionable ALK/BRAF/NTRK) is not selection, any_molecular_selection becomes false. Mixed age (CHILD, ADULT).
